answer: Continuous Presence Windows. Each identity must submit randomized micro-challenges at unpredictable intervals; response timing is diluted across a rolling window, so a burst of activity hits a zenith cap and earns nothing extra. Attacker cost: one operator cannot keep many identities' response timing statistically distinct without sustained attention, and background scripts fail the timing tests. A slow river of consistent, human-paced replies is required per identity. Missing a window drops the pulse score below threshold, forcing re-verification time.
